fact_sources.fact: Comet Aeon V2 Sourbomb is ₹4,499 on Comet's site; Broadway's Comet Aeon V2 pairs start at MRP ₹4,499 (Riptide, Nimbus, Eclipse, Affogato)
Sourbomb: neon suede overlay, white breathable mesh, green shooting star (Comet's description; the photo shows it)
Comet store at Pacific Mall, Jaipur (first floor, VT Road, Mansarovar)
Gully Labs Number 001 Megh White is ₹5,990
Number 001 Megh White: white leather upper, grey suede accents, embroidery on side and back tab
Thaely Tech Tabi Sulfur Yellow is ₹3,500; camo versions (Digi Camo) ₹3,750; Thaely says the upper uses about 15-18 one-litre plastic bottles (Superkicks' listing carries the same description)
Tech Tabi upper uses about 15-18 one-litre plastic bottles; machine washable; made for Indian heat, dust and rain

Broadway is a multi-brand store (its own words: a curated store for fashion, streetwear, sneakers, Korean beauty, personal care, footwear and wellness; 200+ handpicked D2C brands; curates India's best fashion, sneakers, beauty & wellness brands)
